title: Schediel native widget snapshot, schema version 1.0
description: Written by the Flutter app as one JSON string under the home_widget key 'schediel_widget_snapshot' (Android SharedPreferences 'HomeWidgetPreferences'; iOS App Group UserDefaults). Read by the Android AppWidgetProvider and the iOS WidgetKit timeline provider. Mirrors CONTRACTS.md section 6. The whole snapshot is replaced in one write; readers never merge revisions. Native readers that do not support schemaVersion render the safe open-app state.

deviceTimeZone.description: IANA zone used for labels at generation; readers format times in the current device zone

coverageEnd.description: UTC instant after which the snapshot no longer justifies now/next labels; readers show the stale open-app state at or after it

widgets.description: Per-widget projections keyed by native widget identity (Android appWidgetId as a decimal string; iOS configuration identity). Key 'default' is used for widgets without their own entry.

x-readerRules: R01 Timed occurrences: ongoing when startEpochMs <= now < endEpochMs (label Now). A timed occurrence without an end is a point event and is past once now >= startEpochMs.

R02 Next is the resolved timed occurrence with the earliest startEpochMs > now; it receives the emphasized holder when configuration.nextEmphasis is true. Later timed occurrences are Upcoming (quieter holders). Ties keep snapshot order.
R03 Date-only occurrences are shown separately as All day when today's local date is within [startDate, endDateExclusive); they never become Next.
R04 Occurrences with timeStatus needsTimeReview show 'Time needs review' instead of a time and never become Now or Next.
R05 An occurrence whose local start date differs from today shows an explicit date label.
R06 If now >= coverageEnd, show 'Open Schediel to update' instead of claiming nothing is upcoming. If the snapshot is missing, unparsable or has an unsupported schemaVersion, show 'Open Schediel'.
R07 emptyReason noSchedules shows 'No schedules yet'; noneInFilter shows 'No schedules in this filter'; with entries but none remaining shows 'No upcoming schedules'.
R08 Tapping an entry opens its deepLink; tapping elsewhere opens the app. A tap never creates a schedule or enables an alert.
R09 Readers format instants in the current device time zone and locale. zoneLabel, when present, is appended to the time.

R10 Readers request their next refresh at the earliest of: the next start or end boundary after now, the next local midnight, and coverageEnd, using only platform-supported, budgeted mechanisms. No exact refresh time is promised.

surface.description: clear: no app-painted root background, no blur, subtle holders; softTint: stronger translucent holders; solid: opaque high-contrast holders

textTone.description: Text for light wallpaper (dark text) or dark wallpaper (light text); hosts may override

startEpochMs.description: Timed and resolved: start instant; otherwise null

endEpochMs.description: Timed with an end: end instant; otherwise null

startDate.description: Local start date (source zone for timed, calendar date for date-only)

location.description: Present only when allowed by the widget's visible details
